items.summary: Tencent has open-sourced HunyuanImage 3.0, an image generation model with 80 billion parameters that handles multiple modalities natively.

items.title_zh: OpenAI 与英伟达宣布合作部署 10GW 英伟达系统
items.summary: OpenAI and Nvidia announced a partnership to deploy 10 gigawatts of Nvidia systems.

items.title: Beyond the Front Page: A Personal Guide to Hacker News
items.title_zh: 超越首页：一份个人化的 Hacker News 阅读指南
items.summary: The author describes Hacker News as an external comment section for the internet and a map to new questions, while arguing that it cannot replace the internet or one's own thinking.

items.title: Privacy and Security Risks in the eSIM Ecosystem [pdf]
items.title_zh: eSIM 生态系统中的隐私与安全风险
items.summary: A USENIX Security paper examines privacy and security risks across the eSIM ecosystem.

items.title: Altoids by the Fistful
items.title_zh: 一把接一把的 Altoids 薄荷糖
items.summary: An essay that opens with the Wikipedia definition of evolutionary maladaptation, which the author pointedly notes was looked up on Wikipedia rather than with a large language model.

items.title: Libghostty is coming
items.title_zh: libghostty 即将到来
items.summary: Mitchell Hashimoto says libghostty is taking shape, starting with libghostty-vt, a zero-dependency library extracted from Ghostty's core that parses terminal sequences and maintains terminal state.

items.title: EU age verification app not planning desktop support
items.title_zh: 欧盟年龄验证应用不打算支持桌面端
items.summary: A commenter on the technical specification for the EU's age-verification app raises usability concerns, arguing that the design assumes everyone owns a smartphone and that desktop support is not planned.

items.title: Python developers are embracing type hints
items.title_zh: Python 开发者正在拥抱类型提示
items.summary: A Pyrefly blog post introduces typed Python, explains why type hints matter to Python developers today, and offers guidance on how to get started.

items.title: ChatControl: EU wants to scan all private messages, even in encrypted apps
items.title_zh: ChatControl：欧盟希望扫描所有私密消息，包括加密应用
items.summary: The EU is pushing legislation that would scan all private messages, including those in encrypted apps, according to the article.

items.title: Resurrect the Old Web
items.title_zh: 重振旧日互联网
items.summary: The article opens with a local Maine news report about middle schoolers calling their friends on landline telephones, using the story to reflect on reviving the old web.

items.title: Fast UDP I/O for Firefox in Rust
items.title_zh: 用 Rust 为 Firefox 实现快速 UDP I/O
items.summary: The post explains work on fast UDP I/O for Firefox in Rust, motivated by HTTP/3 traffic running over QUIC and UDP and by the dated UDP APIs Firefox inherits from NSPR.

items.title: Translating a Fortran F-16 Simulator to Unity3D
items.title_zh: 将 Fortran 版 F-16 模拟器移植到 Unity3D
items.summary: A developer describes translating Fortran source code for an F-16 flight simulation, taken from a textbook appendix and built on lookup tables from wind tunnel data, into a Unity3D project.

items.title: Handy – Free open-source speech-to-text app written in Rust
items.title_zh: Handy：用 Rust 编写的免费开源语音转文字应用
items.summary: Handy is a cross-platform, open-source speech-to-text application for desktop computers, written in Rust.

items.title: Typst: A Possible LaTeX Replacement
items.title_zh: Typst：可能取代 LaTeX 的选择
items.summary: Typst is a document typesetting program that the article describes as especially well suited to technical material and a possible replacement for LaTeX.

items.title: Scm2wasm: A Scheme to WASM compiler in 600 lines of C, making use of WASM GC
items.title_zh: Scm2wasm：600 行 C 写的 Scheme 转 WASM 编译器，利用 WASM GC
items.summary: Scm2wasm is a Scheme-to-WebAssembly compiler written in roughly 600 lines of C that makes use of WebAssembly garbage collection.

items.title: Why I'm not rushing to take sides in the RubyGems fiasco
items.title_zh: 我为何不急着在 RubyGems 风波中站队
items.summary: The author reflects on the ongoing RubyGems controversy and explains why he is not rushing to take a side in the debate.

items.title: Cap'n Web: a new RPC system for browsers and web servers
items.title_zh: Cap'n Web：面向浏览器与 Web 服务器的新型 RPC 系统
items.summary: Cap'n Web is a new open-source, JavaScript-native RPC protocol for browsers and web servers that offers the expressive power of Cap'n Proto without schemas or boilerplate.

items.title: Microsoft blocks Israel’s use of its tech in mass surveillance of Palestinians
items.title_zh: Microsoft 阻止以色列将其技术用于对巴勒斯坦人的大规模监控
items.summary: Microsoft ended a military unit's access to its AI and data services after The Guardian revealed a secret surveillance project, the newspaper reported in an exclusive.

items.title_zh: 腾讯开源 800 亿参数多模态图像生成模型 HunyuanImage 3.0
items.summary: Tencent has open-sourced HunyuanImage 3.0, an image generation model with 80 billion parameters that handles multiple modalities natively.

items.title_zh: 阿里将 Qwen 定位为“AI 时代的 Android”，推进 520 亿美元基建计划
items.summary: At the 2025 Apsara Conference in Hangzhou, Alibaba CEO Eddie Wu said the company is carrying out a three-year RMB 380 billion (US$52 billion) plan to expand its infrastructure, while pitching Qwen as the "Android of the AI era."

items.title: Xiaomi 17 debuts Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 as CEO Lei Jun details XRING chip and high-end tech strategy
items.title_zh: 小米 17 首发骁龙 8 Elite Gen 5，雷军详解玄戒芯片与高端化战略
items.summary: Xiaomi's 17 debuts with the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5, as founder Lei Jun used his sixth annual Beijing speech, themed "Change," to review the company's transformation and detail its XRING chip and high-end technology strategy.

items.title: BEYOND Expo Announces XIN Summit — A New China-Focused Tech Summit Launching in Shenzhen on November 15-16, 2025
items.title_zh: BEYOND Expo 推出 XIN 峰会，11 月 15–16 日登陆深圳
items.summary: BEYOND Expo announced XIN Summit, a new China-focused tech summit in Shenzhen on November 15-16, 2025, spotlighting next-generation innovators and anchored by the AI hardware ecosystem and frontier technologies.

items.title: AVATR Plans Hong Kong IPO Filing in Q4 2025, Listing Targeted for Next Year
items.title_zh: AVATR 计划 2025 年第四季度提交香港 IPO 申请，目标明年上市
items.summary: AVATR Technology, backed by Changan Auto, Huawei and CATL, is preparing to file for a Hong Kong IPO in the fourth quarter of 2025, with a listing targeted for next year.

items.title: MediaTek’s Dimensity 9500 hits 4000+ single-core score, rivals Apple A19 Pro
items.title_zh: 联发科 Dimensity 9500 单核得分突破 4000，叫板 Apple A19 Pro
items.summary: MediaTek unveiled its Dimensity 9500 flagship processor, built on a third-generation 3nm process with an all-big-core design; a 4000+ single-core score is reported to rival Apple's A19 Pro.

items.title: China approves 156 game licenses in September, including miHoYo’s Honkai: Nexus Anima
items.title_zh: 中国 9 月批准 156 款游戏版号，包括 miHoYo 的 Honkai: Nexus Anima
items.summary: China's National Press and Publication Administration approved licenses for 156 games in September, including 145 domestic titles and miHoYo's Honkai: Nexus Anima, TechNode reports.

items.title: Xiaomi Unveils Retro Handheld-Style Case for 17 Pro and Pro Max
items.title_zh: 小米为 17 Pro 和 Pro Max 推出复古掌机风格保护壳
items.summary: Xiaomi has released a retro handheld game console-style protective case for its 17 Pro and 17 Pro Max smartphones, TechNode reports.

items.title: Xiaomi Pad 8 Series to Support macOS Ecosystem
items.title_zh: 小米 Pad 8 系列将支持 macOS 生态
items.summary: Xiaomi announced that its upcoming Pad 8 series will debut with HyperOS 3 and be compatible with Apple's macOS ecosystem.

items.title: GradientHQ/parallax
items.title_zh: GradientHQ/parallax：随处搭建自有 AI 集群的分布式模型服务框架
items.summary: Parallax is a distributed model serving framework that lets users build their own AI cluster anywhere, written in Python.

items.title: HailToDodongo/pyrite64
items.title_zh: HailToDodongo/pyrite64：基于 libdragon 的 N64 游戏引擎与编辑器
items.summary: Pyrite64 is an N64 game engine and editor built on libdragon and tiny3d, written in C++.

items.title: vercel-labs/coding-agent-template
items.title_zh: vercel-labs/coding-agent-template：多 Agent AI 编程平台模板
items.summary: A Vercel Labs template for a multi-agent AI coding platform built on Vercel Sandbox and AI Gateway, written in TypeScript.

items.title: raphaelsalaja/userinterface-wiki
items.title_zh: userinterface-wiki：更好的界面设计活手册
items.summary: A TypeScript project described as "A Living Manual for Better Interfaces," presented as a living reference for interface design.

items.title: oxylabs/ai-scraper-py
items.title_zh: oxylabs/ai-scraper-py
items.summary: AI Scraper is a scraping tool and scrape agent built to automate data extraction with high precision across diverse web sources, according to its repository description.

items.title: AHEKOT/ComfyUI_VNCCS
items.title_zh: AHEKOT/ComfyUI_VNCCS：视觉小说角色创建套件
items.summary: Visual Novel Character Creation Suite is a ComfyUI tool for building character sprites for visual novels, designed to keep a character's appearance consistent across all images, something the listing says was previously difficult with neural networks.

items.title: lupantech/AgentFlow
items.title_zh: lupantech/AgentFlow：智能体系统的流程内优化
items.summary: AgentFlow is a Python project described as an in-the-flow optimization approach for agentic systems.

items.title: sammyuri/craftgpt
items.title_zh: sammyuri/craftgpt：在 Minecraft 里搭建的小型语言模型
items.summary: CraftGPT is a small language model built inside Minecraft, with the repository written in Python.

items.title: EVV1E/waylandcraft
items.title_zh: EVV1E/waylandcraft：在 Minecraft 中实现的 Wayland 合成器
items.summary: Waylandcraft implements a Wayland compositor inside Minecraft, according to its repository description; the project is written in Java.

items.title: moazbuilds/CodeMachine-CLI
items.title_zh: moazbuilds/CodeMachine-CLI：编排 AI 编程智能体的开源工具
items.summary: CodeMachine is an open-source TypeScript tool for turning AI coding agents into repeatable workflows that can run for long periods.

items.title: Painless Activation Steering: An Automated, Lightweight Approach for Post-Training Large Language Models
items.title_zh: Painless Activation Steering：面向大语言模型后训练的自动化轻量方法
items.summary: Researchers introduce Painless Activation Steering (PAS), a family of fully automated activation-steering methods that need only a labeled dataset; across three open-weight models and 18 tasks, PAS improved behavior tasks but not intelligence-oriented tasks. Its introspective variant, iPAS, produced the strongest causal steering effects, including 34.8% on alignment.

items.title: From Human Annotation to Automation: LLM-in-the-Loop Active Learning for Arabic Sentiment Analysis
items.title_zh: 从人工标注到自动化：面向阿拉伯语情感分析的 LLM 在环主动学习
items.summary: The paper proposes an active-learning framework for Arabic sentiment analysis and compares human labeling with LLM-assisted labeling using five models across three benchmark datasets. It reports that LLM-assisted labeling achieved competitive or superior accuracy while reducing annotation needs.

items.title: The Impact of Role Design in In-Context Learning for Large Language Models
items.title_zh: 角色设计对大型语言模型上下文学习的影响
items.summary: The study examines how role configurations in prompts affect in-context learning with GPT-3.5, GPT-4o, Llama2-7b and Llama2-13b across sentiment analysis, text classification, question answering and math reasoning. The authors suggest role-based prompt structuring has the potential to improve LLM performance.

items.title: An Analysis of Kalman Filter based Object Tracking Methods for Fast-Moving Tiny Objects
items.title_zh: 面向快速移动微小物体的卡尔曼滤波目标跟踪方法分析
items.summary: The study evaluates five Kalman filter-based trackers on 10,000 annotated racquetball frames and finds they all drift significantly for fast-moving tiny objects, with DeepOCSORT achieving the lowest tracking error and ByteTrack the fastest inference.

items.title: Blueprint-Bench: Comparing spatial intelligence of LLMs, agents and image models
items.title_zh: Blueprint-Bench：比较 LLM、智能体与图像模型的空间智能
items.summary: Blueprint-Bench evaluates spatial reasoning by asking models to convert apartment photographs into 2D floor plans; across GPT-5, Claude 4 Opus, Gemini 2.5 Pro, Grok-4, image models and agent systems, most scored at or below a random baseline while human performance remained substantially better.

items.title: Towards Multimodal Active Learning: Efficient Learning with Limited Paired Data
items.title_zh: 迈向多模态主动学习：利用有限配对数据高效学习
items.summary: The paper introduces a framework for multimodal active learning with unaligned data, where the learner actively acquires cross-modal alignments, and reports that it can cut annotation requirements by up to 40% on the ColorSwap dataset without losing accuracy.

items.title: Evaluating point-light biological motion in multimodal large language models
items.title_zh: 评估多模态大语言模型对点光生物运动的理解
items.summary: The authors introduce ActPLD, described as the first benchmark for evaluating action processing in multimodal LLMs using point-light displays of human body motion. They report consistently low performance across proprietary and open-source models, pointing to gaps in action and spatiotemporal understanding.

items.title: Unified Multi-Modal Interactive & Reactive 3D Motion Generation via Rectified Flow
items.title_zh: 基于整流流的多模态双人交互与反应式 3D 动作生成统一框架
items.summary: The paper introduces DualFlow, a unified framework for two-person 3D motion generation conditioned on text, music, or prior motion. It combines rectified flow with a retrieval-augmented module and reports state-of-the-art results across interactive, reactive, and multimodal benchmarks.
